integrity_note: The general theorem is proved by a support normal form, invariant-matrix enumeration, and Burnside orbit counting. Standalone finite checks are reproducibility controls, not proof for arbitrary size. Prior semantic and chain-frame results are acknowledged; no independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact labelled and isomorphism counts concern modal relations satisfying forward confluence on the complete two-level poset only. No seriality, reflexivity, modal transitivity, valuations, bisimulation quotient, or logical complexity is asserted. An unindexed equivalent enumeration remains possible.
title: Cycle-index census of forward-confluent relations on complete two-level intuitionistic frames
